body_markdown:
# Knowledge Repository Governance

## Purpose

Govern the knowledge base as an architecture repository (spec §16, §21, §33).

## Scope

All content in this repository, including `00-system/`.

## Repository Roles

Machine-readable in `00-system/governance/roles.yaml` (repository roles and governance roles, with members).

| Role | Accountable for | May |
|---|---|---|
| Knowledge Owner | content of an object | create, edit, request review |
| Domain Owner | coherence of a domain | approve domain objects, assign reviewers, resolve conflicts |
| Reviewer | content review | set validated / reviewed, reject |
| Approver | governance decision | set approved, authoritative, approve deprecation |
| Publisher | releases, products | set published, tag releases |
| Maintainer | `00-system`, tooling, CI | change schemas, vocabularies, validation |
| LLM assistant | nothing | discover, extract, propose, classify, link, validate — **never** approve, publish or overwrite authoritative knowledge |

Every important object carries `owner`, `reviewer`, `version`, `created`, `updated`, `review_date` and `status` (approval status is derived from `status`, see [[Separate Lifecycle Status from Knowledge Quality]]).

## Git Workflow

```text
Branch → Change → Automated validation (CI) → Review → Approval → Merge → Publication (tag)
```

- Four workflows run on every pull request: validate-schema, validate-knowledge, validate-links and governance-check. BLOCKING ERRORs fail the build; WARNINGs must be acknowledged in the PR description.
- Approval is established by an append-only governance record (`00-system/governance/records/`) with one decision per required governance level — see [[Status Change Requires Governance Record]] and [[Knowledge Change Review Process]].
- Status transitions are checked against the lifecycle; ID changes are rejected.
- Changes to objects with quality `authoritative` raise a warning that explicit approval must be recorded in the pull request.

## Human-in-the-Loop

```text
LLM: discover · extract · propose · classify · link · validate
                     ▼
Human architect: review · decide · approve
                     ▼
            Knowledge repository
```

Generation is not approval. LLM-created objects enter at status `proposed` with quality `draft`, owner `unassigned`, and `sources: []` unless a verified source exists.

## LLM Build Workflow (spec §32)

Inspect taxonomy → inspect existing concepts → identify gaps → propose objects → check duplicates (validator label-collision warnings) → create objects → create relationships → validate metadata → validate governance → identify conflicts → propose changes (pull request) → human approval → publish.
